descricao_original: The morphology of serous and mucous secretory units is demonstrated in this image. Each serous unit is acinar with a narrow lumen and contains cells with secretory granules and spherical nuclei. Each mucous unit is tubular with a wide lumen. The secretory cells appear vacuolated, with nuclei flattened at the base of the cell. Submandibular gland 1000x
